mode.title: Export mode
mode.description: Use `list` for saved lead lists (`/sales/lists/people/...`) or `search` for Sales Navigator people search URLs.

listUrl.title: Lead list URL or ID
listUrl.description: Full Sales Navigator lead list URL (e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/sales/lists/people/123456789) or numeric list ID. Required when mode is `list`.

searchUrl.title: People search URL
searchUrl.description: Full Sales Navigator people search URL. Required when mode is `search`.

maxLeads.title: Max leads
maxLeads.description: Maximum number of leads to export (1–2000).

unipileApiKey.title: Unipile API key
unipileApiKey.description: Your Unipile API key (X-API-KEY). Can also be set via UNIPILE_API_KEY env var on the Actor.

unipileAccountId.title: Unipile LinkedIn account ID
unipileAccountId.description: LinkedIn account connected in Unipile (account_id). Can also be set via UNIPILE_ACCOUNT_ID env var.

pageDelayMs.title: Delay between pages (ms)
pageDelayMs.description: Pause between paginated API calls to reduce rate-limit risk.
